## Description
The MD4 Nuclear Reactor is a robust, flight-ready nuclear fission power plant. With the thermal conversion efficiency of 27.4% and at 83.3% load capacity, it provides a consistent power supply of ~99.83 kWe. It also includes a 80 kWh backup battery.
